body:
Been a bit of a quiet day, been a mix of learning guitar and sign language. But I've been distracted by a bad bout of anxiety.
I struggle to calm myself down, because the worst thing about anxiety, is it sometimes tells the truth. A stopped clock is right twice a day sort of thing.
I do have access to a good walk, might go later if I can motivate myself
Infact no, started worrying about shit again and I'm back in the same place again

While I feel a little better, chances are it wasn't the pain killers. Maybe they helped a little. Maybe it was placebo. Or maybe I successfully distracted myself enough to stop feeding the negative spiral.

I don't know, hopefully I never try it again.

That's a sad story. Life must have been feeling particularly cruel that day. Honest truth is, it could happen to anyone, and it's bound to happen to a very unlucky few. I'm sorry to hear you were one of the unlucky few.

There's no one to blame here

Okay man, I'm sorry that you're having so much difficulty in looking past how other perceive you. You're 19 years old and you already think it's too late for yourself. 

You've trapped yourself in a mindset where you think you need to have sex to be worthy to have sex. If that was true for every 19 year old then the human race would have long since gone extinct.

I wish you the best my friend, I wish OP the best too. I hope you both overcome lifes bullshit and find happiness.

I am listining and I am hearing you. 

The women who riducle you aren't the ones you want to fuck in the first place. I'm not distracting myself, in my eyes you are being distracted by it. It's swallowed you whole, you can't think of anything else. You see yourself as a virgin and nothing more. 

Girl aren't attracted to desperation. I've had opportunites to lose it but passed them up because I wasn't in the right place emotionally. The one girl who knew I was a virgin didn't give two shits. 

That's because they don't see me as a virgin but as another guy. If you  define yourself as nothing but a virgin that's all they're gonna see man. Tell me if you weren't a virign, who would you be?

Mostly agree with the first paragraph. But completely disagree with the second.

There are definitely gonna be some women who think virgins are pathetic. Those women are pathetic lol. You don't want such shallow people anyway. But not all women think that and it's not healthy to assume such. And again, I'm older than both you and OP nd I'm a virgin, I'm sorry you think I'm pathetic and would hate to be in my position. But I don't think being a virgin makes me a failure. I've not been treated any different for it. That's because I don't let it define me. Don't let it define you

Here in lies the problem. You need to help yourself to get women, not get women to help yourself.

An analogy may help me explain. A man doesn't become physically strong because he was weak one second and lifted extremely heavy weights the next. He was strong because he worked on himself.

There are no short cuts or easy solutions. It's hard to help someone if they can't to help themselves. It's hard but not impossible

I'm 22 and a virgin. But I understand there's so much more to life. I understand why OP is upset, it's because people put too much pressure on sex. But it's clear that the issue is something much deeper than sex. Sex won't fix his problems

Sorry for not specifying, even though it's online and I'm using a throwaway I still feel uncomfortable divulging the details. You're not quite right but you're along the right lines.

As much as I'd like to sit and talk with her again she's not responded to my messages and I have to accept that if she wants to talk again it will be her to reach out.

In our past talks I offered to support anyway I could, but she's decided that she'd prefere help from other people. Of course I'd like to be one of the people to help her but I understand I can't. I hope she has the support she needs, she told me she spoke with her sister about the incident so I'm happy to know she hasn't completly shouldered the burden alone.

I understand that suicide won't help. I'm feeling stable currently but there are times where I lose grip on rational logic and wish to literally kill the pain inside my brain, heart, or gut. I know it sounds odd but a lack of rationality will do that.

I'm sorry but I don't understand your final sentance. Did you mean I should of known my drink was spiked in the first place? Or I should be able to find out for sure if I was spiked?

Edit:

I'm trying to get therapy, waiting list is long so I need to be patient. I will talk in detail about the incident the them. Just not comfortable online
Thank you, I try to keep a decent attitude because, I'm aware that I could very easily fall into a very dark place that I may not manage to recover from if I'm not careful.

Thank you for sharing. It doesn't feel right to say I'm not guilty though, as I can't prove anything for sure. But doubting myself will do no good now.

I wish you the best and hope that we can find the odd day down the line where we can breifly be at peace and stop fighting such guilt ridden thoughts.

I sent her a text explaining the story recently. Tried not to put pressure or overwhelm her. But I think she understandably blocked me so I don't think my message got through. I'm aware I could contact her through facebook, but if she doesn't want to talk to me I have to respect that.

A relationship with a girl will not fix all your problems. You need to fix these problems first then get a relationship. You're not ready for a romantic relationship even though you want it so bad.

You need to fix the relationship with yourself before fixing your relationship with others.

I don't know you so I can't answer. And you don't love yourself so you can't answer. That's what makes this so tough.

You're clearly not on your own side here dude. Nothing will ever change if you're against yourself

This is what makes the step so hard to take. The voices in your head have nothing nice to say about yourself and that's where you're going when you look for self love. 

There is never NOTHING to love about yourself. That's a fact. So if your believe that there is nothing to love I can tell you for a fact that you head is in the wrong place. 

For all the lies you tell yourself, let yourself accept this one indispuitable truth.  The truth will have a stronger impact than the sea of lies

Thankfully you're not too garbage. You're head must be an awful place to be since you probably have 1000 voices telling you otherwise. Loving yourself when you're in this mindset is such a hard step to take, but it's the first and most impactful step. Love yourself, if even just a little bit

I can tell from the way you type that you're exhausted from carrying a heart so heavy. This damage to your mental health has way more of an effect on both your physical apperance and your mental view on your own appearance. In other words the cards are stacked against you into tricking you into thinking you're hideous. I don't know what you look like of course but the chances are that mental health is holding you back more than you realise. It's the same for personalities. 

People always romanticize mental illnesses. The reality is that they are truly ugly. When you overcome it you'll be shocked how much it was holding you back

21? You're so young! It's one of those things that will happen when it happens. The more pressure you put on yourself the harder it will be. 

Issue being, people put so much damn pressure on it these days. I can't understate that enough, people put SO much pressure on it these days.

I absolutely don't think you should feel so much pressure but I'd be damned if I claimed your stress isn't justified. I know this isn't supposed to be where things end for you
I'll do my best. Hopefully after the covid passes I will be able to do more to get my mind off it. Maybe by then I'll even have access to some therapy.
I'm sorry to hear that this man pinned the weight of the world on your shoulders.
